Rockets @ Nuggets 7/10 9:00 - Jokic hosts Houston, Sengun questionable
Raptors @ Pistons 5/10 6:30 - Cade's Pistons vs thin Raptors
Pelicans @ Thunder 3/10 7:00 - SGA's thin Thunder vs depleted Pelicans

games.notes: Sengun and Adams questionable, Capela out for Houston. Jokic healthy for Denver, so a mid team gets a real shot at a contender; should be close.
Kawhi, Barrett and Murray-Boyles out for Toronto; Duren and Robinson out for Detroit. Cade and the Pistons favored, young teams but short-handed, probably decent not great.
Reaves out for LA; Hunter questionable for Sacramento. Lakers are far better, likely blowout.
Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Wallace out for OKC, Caruso questionable; Murray, Mathurin out and Murphy questionable for New Orleans. SGA's thin Thunder should still win comfortably.
Caleb Wilson out for Chicago; Wizards missing Champagnie and Beekman. Two bad young teams, could be close but low quality.
Haliburton out for Indiana, Mobley and Tyson out for Cleveland. Two middling, banged-up teams.
Knueppel, Schroder and Allen out for Charlotte; McCollum out for Atlanta. Hawks should win, little to enjoy.
Banchero and Isaac out for Orlando. A mid team without its star against a bad Nets team, skip.
Markkanen and Jaren Jackson Jr. out for Utah, Mark Williams out for Phoenix. Two teams with nothing to offer, skip.
